translation:
For any types P, D, E and R, S3(P,D,E,R) is the type of records t with four fields: t.c1 assigns a set of elements of D to each p in P; t.c2 assigns a set of elements of E to each o in D; t.c3 assigns an element of R to each o in D; and t.c4 assigns an element of E to each r in R. No further conditions are imposed on the fields.

D17(t) is the set of all o in D for which there exists a p in P with o in t.c1(p).

D18(t,o), for o in D, is the proposition that o belongs to D17(t) and t.c4(t.c3(o)) does not belong to t.c2(o).

D19(t,r), for r in R, is the set of all p in P for which there exists an o in t.c1(p) with t.c3(o) = r.

D20(t,p), for p in P, is the set of all e in E for which there exists an o in t.c1(p) with e in t.c2(o). There is no restriction on t.c3(o) in this definition.

D21(t,r), for r in R, is the proposition that there exists a function S from the elements of D19(t,r) to the elements of that same set, and there exists a p in D19(t,r), such that D20(t,p) and D20(t,S(p)) have no element in common. Here D20 uses the underlying elements of P. S must be defined on all of D19(t,r), but disjointness is required only for the chosen p. There is no requirement that S(p) differ from p; if they are equal, disjointness means D20(t,p) is empty.

D22(t,r), for r in R, is the proposition that there exists an o in D17(t) with t.c3(o) = r.

D23(t) is the proposition that for every r in R, if D22(t,r) holds, then D21(t,r) holds. Thus the witnesses S and p may depend on r, and no witnesses are required for an r not attained by t.c3 on D17(t). D18 is not a hypothesis or a conclusion of D23. These definitions name sets and propositions; they do not assert that the propositions hold.

divergences.description: The passage writes inf(o); Lean represents it as c4(c3(o)). Thus two datasets with the same report content must yield the same inference. This factorization accords with the passage’s description of o_r as the part used for inference.

Lean distinguishes the ambient types D and R from the datasets and reports that can arise. It supplies c2 and c3 even on unattainable datasets, and c4 even on unattained reports. D23, however, requires substitutions only for attained reports, implementing the declared reading of “for every o_r.”

judgement.summary: Under the declared readings, the definitions match the passage. In particular, D21 preserves report content through the domain and codomain of S, while requiring disjointness of the full pred∘obs sets for at least one p, not for every p.
